messages:
alex_devex: Quick check — SDK v1.5 ship gate is set for tomorrow EOD (UTC). Need explicit owners for: changelog cutoff, docs quickstart cutover, sample-app smoke, and final PR approvals. Can people call dibs?

mira_docs: I can own docs quickstart cutover. Will do a final pass tonight and push redirects. ETA: 2h.

sam_engineering: I can take sample-app smoke and the packaging sanity. Will run the matrix on the new samples and update the README snippets. Any specific envs to test?

alex_devex: Sam — focus on linux x86 + mac intel runners. If windows CI is green that's bonus but not blocker. Also verify `pip install redwood-sdk==1.5.0rc1` works.

sam_engineering: Got it. Will run CLI install + run the hello-world quickstart and the streaming example.

mira_docs: For docs cutover plan: I'll: 1) update /sdk/quickstart to new snippets, 2) add a short migration note, 3) set changelog link to the release PR once Ryan posts. If anyone has copy edits pls ping.

ryan_release: I can own the changelog cutoff and the release PR. I'll open the release candidate PR in ~30m. Cutoff will be last commit to the release branch by T-2h before EOD. After that only critical fixes with an approval from me + Alex.

lucy_qe: I can do a quick smoke matrix on staging (latency sanity, basic generation, embeddings). Can run 10 sample prompts across the three sample apps. ETA: 3h. If anything fails, I'll tag @sam_engineering for fixes.

alex_devex: Thanks all. Two logistical asks: 1) leave a short note in the release PR about doc redirect timing, 2) call out any non-backwards-compatible snippet changes in the PR body.

ryan_release: Will do. Also adding a `release-note` checklist to the PR body: changelog entry, docs link, sample-app tag, packaging SHA.

release-bot: [automated] Release candidate branch created: refs/heads/release/v1.5-rc1 by ryan_release. CI: queued.

sam_engineering: CI found a flake in sample-app Dockerfile (pip cache path). Pushing a fix in a small PR and will re-run smoke after merge.

lucy_qe: Noted — I'll wait for merge and re-trigger my run.

mira_docs: One more: do we want to update the quickstart code block to the new `Client` constructor shape? It changes param order a bit. If yes, I'll update snippets and add a short callout.

alex_devex: Yes, update snippets. Add a tiny migration snippet: `# before` / `# after` with 1-2 lines. Keep it minimal.

ryan_release: PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/1845 — includes changelog draft. Tagging owners in PR description.

sam_engineering: Merged fix for Dockerfile (PR 1847). Rebuilding sample images now.

release-bot: [automated] CI passed for release/v1.5-rc1. All checks green.

lucy_qe: Smoke run started. Will post results in ~45m.

alex_devex: If smoke is green and docs are updated, I'll mark ship-gate as OK and we move to final cut. If any blocker, we roll to next-day ship window.

lucy_qe: Smoke results: all green except minor streaming flakiness on one test (timing). Re-ran and passed. Marking as green now.

mira_docs: Docs updated and deployed to staging, quickstart snippets show correctly, migration note in place.

ryan_release: Given green CI, green smoke, and docs deployed to staging, I'm cutting the final release in 30m. Final changelog entry ready.

alex_devex: Awesome — thanks everyone. Post final release notes here once done and I'll send the short announcement draft to #announcements. :tada:

ryan_release: Release published: v1.5.0 — changelog: https://git.company/repo/releases/v1.5.0 — release notes posted.

release-bot: [automated] Release v1.5.0 published and tagged.

alex_devex: Announcement queued. Closing ship-gate thread. Great work! :rocket:
